import re
from datetime import datetime


def parse_nginx_access_log(line: str) -> dict:
    """
    Parse a single nginx access log line (combined log format) into a dictionary.

    Expected format:
    IP - - [timestamp] "METHOD /path HTTP/1.1" status bytes "referer" "user-agent"

    Example input:
    192.168.1.1 - - [10/Oct/2023:13:55:36 +0000] "GET /index.html HTTP/1.1" 200 2326 "-" "Mozilla/5.0"

    Returns:
        dict with keys: ip, ident, user, timestamp, method, path, protocol,
        status, bytes, referer, user_agent
    """
    # Regex for combined log format
    pattern = (
        r'^(?P<ip>\S+)\s+'
        r'(?P<ident>\S+)\s+'
        r'(?P<user>\S+)\s+'
        r'\[(?P<timestamp>[^\]]+)\]\s+'
        r'"(?P<method>\S+)\s+(?P<path>\S+)\s+(?P<protocol>\S+)"\s+'
        r'(?P<status>\d{3})\s+'
        r'(?P<bytes>\d+|-)\s+'
        r'"(?P<referer>[^"]*)"\s+'
        r'"(?P<user_agent>[^"]*)"'
    )

    match = re.match(pattern, line)
    if not match:
        raise ValueError(f"Log line does not match expected nginx access log format: {line}")
